card: This pull request backports #36309 to the 31.x maintenance branch. It updates documentation to mark the private transaction broadcast feature as experimental and clarifies its privacy characteristics in terms of risk reduction rather than absolute guarantees. It also updates the v31.x release notes.
evidence: Commit d1e2b3e56b states 'doc: scope claims about private broadcast feature: Reframe in terms of risk reduction rather than absolutes'.
Commit 6701d7c329 states 'private broadcast: mark feature as experimental'.
problem: Documentation for the private broadcast feature previously made overly strong guarantees regarding privacy and anonymity instead of framing privacy benefits in terms of risk reduction, and the feature was not explicitly designated as experimental.

risk.why: The commits backported from #36309 only adjust documentation, warning text, and release notes without changing consensus or validation rules.

scope_notes: The PR title and description note backporting #36309 onto the 31.x branch. The diff contains a large set of changes across build files, doc, and test harness files typical of accumulated branch diffs when comparing across release branches.
summary: This pull request backports changes to the 31.x maintenance branch, specifically cherry-picking #36309 to clarify claims and mark the private broadcast feature as experimental, along with updating release notes for v31.x.
